subject: U-CHAIN r3 FINAL integrated: all gates green, Greptile APPROVED, 1 new P2 held
body: Ran the full r3 integrate gate at d75b23b1 and pushed it: gitleaks clean over b431c418..HEAD (19 commits, 0 findings), suite Ran 1707 tests in 289.117s OK, scripts/validate.py clean (21 missions valid), and run_mutants-r3.py exit 0 with 31 mutants -- 28/28 KILLED-for-assertion, 0 survivors, 0 false reds, 0 stillborn, both controls GREEN; egress receipt e925b0fc written 09:15:54Z, 22s before the 09:16:16Z push. The push resolved as a FAST-FORWARD (b431c418..d75b23b1, no leading '+') because the trailer-stripped commits had never reached origin -- the lease was still explicitly pinned to b431c418 and held, and bare force was never used. Greptile RAN on the new head (first activity 127s, settled 191s, check pass) and APPROVED it, raising exactly one NEW comment, BOT-6 (P2, mutants_core.py:116, 'Interrupted runs skip restoration'), which I tagged VALID and HELD unfixed -- its claim is exact but its consequence is not silent, since the fixed-head positive control makes the harness fail closed on a corrupted baseline; both r2 holds are FIXED at the new head and neither was re-raised (BOT-4 freshness clause now bound by 3 new mutants, BOT-5 baseline now self-derived from a pinned SHA and hash-checked), and BOT-3's residual phrase gap that r2 refused to close is now bound by 3 live mutants. WHAT'S LEFT, and it blocks merge: ALL SIX Greptile threads on PR #484 (BOT-1..BOT-6) still have ZERO in-thread replies -- I did not post them because this dispatch is HOLD-only and forbids the GitHub-comment channel, so full pasteable dispositions for all six are written up in the report; Greptile's APPROVED is a green check, not an answered thread. Report committed as ca616c77 (maintainer author, no trailers) and fast-forward pushed, so origin is now ca616c77 and a fresh Greptile run on that report-only commit is expected and not yet reviewed.
